summary: Capture treats `(blocks, depth)` as a layer list, so every real capture crashes.
Expensive generation/capture/fit/null phases have no default skip/resume contract.
Pod outputs upload to HF but P3 has no HF-to-local staging path.
SR1 requires seed43-to-seed44 retrieval; code computes only Pearson reliability.
H2 lacks GPQA shared-row intersections, paired bootstraps, and the exact n=7 requirement.
Judge fallback skips the registered pilot and never merges verdicts into reported metrics.
Odd-layer mode writes and uploads through the primary fit/null/result filenames.
G2 gates a different assembly/fitter path and accepts stale status-only sentinels.
Pinned banked completion key coverage is not checked before heavy capture initialization.
The registered 20-draw by 23-lambda batching is implemented as nested serial loops.
Plan requires calibrated arm gaps but registers no GPQA null; amend H2 to explicitly authorize raw-both-surface gaps.
Arm-b ceiling cap 4096 needs explicit plan and compute/disk arithmetic amendment before dispatch.
Fixed (A1): _capture_stage unpacks (blocks, depth) + None guard + layer-bound assert; production-body test runs the real body via a real-shaped decoder wrapper (77bb0d3b5e).
Fixed (B1): phase_done sentinels + _run_phases skip + --force re-entry + per-unit percell resume in fits; test_run_phases_sentinel_skip_and_force pins both (77bb0d3b5e).
